{{Quote|I'm getting approximately twenty life form readings from the main building, General. All in the central section.|AT-AT Commander|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
An''' officer''' served a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] as of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. He served under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Freja Covell]], who himself served [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn's confederation|forces]]. The officer was deployed to [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] with a force of three [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]], one of which he commanded, the ''[[Number Four]]''. His walker scanned [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Myrkr Base]] to give a report to the [[General/Legends|general]].
